answer: Vested-withdrawal escrow turns rewards into nectar tranches released only after a bonded relic accumulates a quorum-signed opal proof: 64 peers must attest over 14 days, with a 5% per-attempt fee, a 3-attempt epoch cap, and a 30-day withdrawal delay. Abandoning an identity forfeits its bond and unvested tranches, so a ring of fakes pays N bonds plus fees while posting parallel trust work, then still loses each escrow at detection.
